close_reason: Added #[non_exhaustive] above #[derive(...)] line, matching the canonical sibling pattern (BlobLookupEntry et al.). cargo test -p jmap-chat-client green, clippy clean, fmt clean. Committed as 67a30f1 (batched with sibling #[non_exhaustive] beads).
description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:69-80.

`TypingResponse` is a `pub struct` deserialized from the wire but lacks `#[non_exhaustive]`. Same rationale as the PushSubscriptionCreateResponse bead. Workspace AGENTS.md mandates `#[non_exhaustive]` on all in-scope response wrappers. The Chat/typing response is small today (only `account_id` + `extra`), which makes today's omission low-impact, but any future spec edit adding (e.g.) a `serverTimestamp` field becomes a breaking change rather than an additive one.

Fix: add `#[non_exhaustive]` above the struct declaration.
title: TypingResponse missing #[non_exhaustive]
